guide.title: Welcome to Arena
guide.description: A blind evaluation system for comparing our RAG-enhanced responses against a standard LLM.
guide.step1: Both panels use the same AI model — one receives retrieved classical text context, the other does not.
guide.step2: Read both responses and vote for the one you find better — you won't know which is which until after voting.
guide.step3: After voting, the reveal panel shows which was RAG-enhanced, along with citations used.
guide.step4: You can continue asking follow-up questions for multi-round evaluation.
guide.footer: Your votes help us improve the system. Thank you for participating!

welcome.title: Welcome to TCM-Sage
welcome.description: An evidence-based Traditional Chinese Medicine research assistant powered by RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and classical text citations.
welcome.arenaDescription: Compare two AI responses side by side and vote for the better one — you won't know which uses our RAG system until after voting. Your votes help us evaluate and improve the system.
welcome.mainChatDescription: Explore the complete RAG system with citation panel, knowledge graph visualization, source verification, and multi-turn conversation.
welcome.footer: This is an academic research project (FYP). Thank you for your participation!
welcome.corpusNote: This system is built on 17 classical TCM texts including Huangdi Neijing, Shang Han Lun, Jin Gui Yao Lue, Shen Nong Ben Cao Jing, Qian Jin Yao Fang, Ben Cao Gang Mu, etc. Questions beyond these texts may not be answered accurately.
